SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CD_PLANT AS PLANT, LEGACY_PO_DATE, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, GR_DATE, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'ILHW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, CD_PLANT AS PLANT, STATUS AS STATUS, LEGACY_PO_DATE||LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, CURRENCY_CODE AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(GR_DATE, ' ') AS GR_DATE, LEGACY_PR_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO, GR_DATE||LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, NVL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, REMARK AS REMARK FROM KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S') AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_DATE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_DATE$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GR_DATE = '$G_RS.GR_DATE$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' ORDER BY GR_DATE, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S') AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_DATE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_DATE$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND GR_DATE = '$G_RS.GR_DATE$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
